findings.description: Boundary BND-UNCLASSIFIED has no explicitly declared boundary_type. A use case (UC-001) and an attempted UIModelEntry both depend on this boundary's software/non-software classification, which cannot be inferred from folder name, participant stereotype, or decomposition eligibility.

clarification_questions: Is BND-UNCLASSIFIED (Unclassified Boundary) a software system with its own UI, or a non-software real-world boundary (e.g., a physical location, an external organization, a manual process)? This must be answered and recorded in main.md's System Boundary section before any UIModelEntry may reference it.
fixture_notes: Demonstrates: status is NEEDS_CLARIFICATION, not a silent PASS defaulting unknown to non-software, and not a silent fabricated UI screen defaulting unknown to software. The attempted UIModelEntry referencing this boundary must not exist in ui-model.json at all -- ui-generatemodel refuses to produce it; this report's finding is defense-in-depth confirmation, not the only safeguard.
